test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 9,900 in 4 years and to Rs. 11,700 in 7 years at the same rate per cent per annum at simple interest. What will be the amount (in Rs.) of the same sum at 9(2)/(3)% for 2(1)/(4) years at simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal and interest rate is same for both two cases of SI.

In 4 years, amount (A₁) = Rs. 9900 

In 7 years, amount (A₂) = Rs. 11700 

Amount of same principal at 9(2)/(3)% for 2(1)/(4) years at SI

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (SI) = P × R × T/100

Total amount = Principal + Simple interest

**Calculation:**

Amount of 4 year = P (1 + 4R/100)

Amount of 7 year = P (1 + 7R/100)

P (1 + 4R/100) = 9900

⇒ P + 4PR/100 = 9900 ----(1)

P (1 + 7R/100) = 11700 

⇒ P + 7PR/100 = 11700 ----(2)

Subtracting equation (1) from equation (2),

⇒ 3PR/100 = 1800

⇒ PR/100 = 600

Substituting the value of PR/100 in equation (1),

⇒ P + 4 × 600 = 9900

⇒ P = 9900 – 2400 = 7500

So, Principal = Rs. 7500

Total amount

⇒ 7500 + 7500 × (9)/(4) × (29)/(300)

⇒ 7500 + 1631.25 = Rs. 9131.25

**∴ The amount is Rs. 9131.25.**
